# Plan: Author Episode 000 and its remaining puzzles

## Sources

`docs/game-design.md` is the authority for all mystery facts and solutions. `src/puzzle/game.ts` and `evaluate.ts` provide `attempt` for `raster` and `inquiry`. `src/narrative/dialogue.ts` selects ECHO lines. `content/puzzles/carrier.json` is Puzzle A. `src/main.ts` holds current tools.

## Content (no engine change for any story text)

- `content/episodes/episode-000.json`: puzzles `puzzle.carrier`, `puzzle.pattern`, `puzzle.archive`; `ending` lines including the design's exact `RELAY 07: RECOVERED` block; `designationPrefix` `OBS`.
- `content/puzzles/pattern.json` (`raster`): 91 bits, 7 rows of 13, spelling survey marks for 4, 1, 7 under the Rev C table. `requires: solved:puzzle.carrier`. Solution width 13, answer `417`. `knownWrong`: `714`, with feedback pointing at the manual revisions. Grants `acquired:tx.grid`.
- `content/puzzles/archive.json` (`inquiry`): `requires: solved:puzzle.pattern`. Fields: first receipt `1999-11-02`; disconnect ordered by `MOYE` (options from the roster); Relay 07 status `RUNNING` (options). Grants `acquired:tx.reconstructed`.
- Carrier gains `grants: acquired:tx.fragment`.
- `content/transmissions/`: `tx.fragment` (the pulse train, with the bits), `tx.grid`, `tx.reconstructed`. `tx.reconstructed` is the final evidence: it sets the received frame beside the JOIN header from the January 2000 handshake specification, bit for bit identical, with the receipt date of 1999-11-02 above it.

Final revelation sequence, all in content: filing the correct report solves `puzzle.archive`, which grants `acquired:tx.reconstructed`, and completes the episode. The ending scene then shows, in order: the body of `tx.reconstructed`, ECHO's comparison (the protocol everyone thought the project invented was in the signal first, and the handshake was copied from it), and the exact `RELAY 07: RECOVERED` block, followed by the designation. `episode.ending` holds this whole sequence as lines, so nothing is hardcoded. Enter then returns to the hub.
- `content/archives/`: the press release (official date 2001-03-14), Field Manual Rev A (1997) and Rev C (1999, says it supersedes earlier revisions, with marks 4 and 7 swapped relative to Rev A), the log-format note (`YYDDD`, with a day-of-year aid), the roster separating `MOYE` from `MOYEN`, a peer-list policy saying only the director can remove a relay, `MOYEN`'s denial, the handshake specification dated January 2000. `searchOnly` with keyword `417`, `requires: solved:puzzle.pattern`: the Relay 07 logbook (several detections, only `99306` is the earliest entry matching 1421.37 MHz at -0.42 Hz/s, including a +0.42 trap and later repeats), Keel's message, and the utility ledger showing draw after the order.
- `content/characters/echo.json`: greeting, reactions per stage, escalating hints per puzzle with no solutions, and a contradiction (two memories of the manual; a memory of 07 lost to a storm against the ledger).

## Tools and engine

- `src/app/tools.ts`: builds the tool list from content and state, so it is generic by puzzle kind, not by id. `ANALYZER` (carrier), `DECODER` (raster), `ARCHIVE` (once any archive is unlocked), `INQUIRY` (inquiry), `TRANSMISSIONS` (once any is acquired), `ECHO`, `STATUS`, `SETTINGS`, `HELP`. A puzzle's tool appears only when `isAvailable`.
- `src/app/hub.ts`: `tools` becomes a function, and the menu refreshes after every tool action.
- `src/puzzle/raster-view.ts`: `RASTER WIDTH` range, a text grid of `#` and `.` in a `pre`, the bit count, `GRID REFERENCE` input, `SUBMIT`.
- `src/puzzle/inquiry-view.ts`: one labelled input or select per field. `FILE REPORT` prints only `n OF m FIELDS CONSISTENT`.
- `src/world/archive.ts` (pure): `searchArchives(archives, query)`. The view always passes `game.archives()`, so `requires` has already been applied. An empty query browses: all unlocked ordinary entries, never `searchOnly` ones. A non-empty query returns ordinary entries matching title, from, board or keyword, plus `searchOnly` entries only when a keyword equals the normalised query.
- `src/world/archive-view.ts`: `SEARCH` input, a result list of buttons, a reading pane. Reading grants `read:<id>`, and ECHO may react.
- `src/app/ending.ts`: a scene showing `episode.ending` over the full viewscreen, then the designation. Enter returns to the hub. Shown once, on completion. The map itself arrives in the next WorkUnit.
- `src/main.ts`: slimmed to wiring. A completed player sees the designation in `STATUS`.

## Files

New: the above, `tests/unit/episode.test.ts`, `tests/unit/archive.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`. Changed: `src/app/hub.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/style.css`, `content/puzzles/carrier.json`, `content/characters/echo.json`, `tests/unit/dialogue.test.ts` if its content assertions need updating, and specs whose tool numbering assumptions change.

## Edge cases

Whitespace and case in answers are already normalised. A locked puzzle's tool is not offered, and `attempt` still refuses it. A reload after completion goes to the hub without replaying the ending.

## Out of scope

Map, post-episode locations, FORGE.

# Test plan

Local commands: `npx vitest run tests/unit/episode.test.ts tests/unit/archive.test.ts tests/unit/dialogue.test.ts`, `npm run content:validate`, `npm run lint`. Browser evidence comes from the PR's `Browser tests` workflow, which runs `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`. Developer and tester may complete with browser evidence pending CI.

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Three kinds of reasoning, and earlier clues required later | `episode.test.ts`: puzzle kinds differ; `pattern` is refused before `carrier`, `archive` before `pattern`; `417` does not reveal the logbook before `pattern`; after `pattern`, an empty or unrelated query does not reveal it and `417` does; the logbook's matching entry contains the carrier's frequency and drift from `carrier.json` | Developer; tester reuses |
| Raster at a width; Rev A and Rev C give different answers, only Rev C correct | `episode.test.ts`: only width 13 of 91 forms marks. The marks are read by parsing the tables out of the real archive bodies: Rev C gives `417`, Rev A gives `714`; `attempt` accepts one and returns the `knownWrong` feedback for the other | Developer; tester reuses |
| Archive search, `417` opens logbook, only a count is reported | `archive.test.ts` for search, including browsing, ordinary keyword search, and a `searchOnly` entry never appearing for an unrelated query; `episode.test.ts` for `attempt` returning `consistent` with no field identity; `episode.spec.ts` for the visible text | Developer; CI |
| Multiple transmissions, several logs, ECHO per stage with a contradiction | `episode.test.ts`: at least 3 transmissions, at least 6 archives, ECHO hints and reactions for each puzzle, two contradiction lines; a scan shows no hint contains a solution value | Developer; tester reuses |
| Ending text, designation, recorded completion | `episode.test.ts`: chain of real answers via `createGame` completes and sets `OBS-` designation; ending contains the comparison, then the exact block, in that order; `tx.reconstructed` contains the same bits as `tx.fragment`, and the specification's JOIN header matches them. `episode.spec.ts` shows the comparison before the block. | Developer; CI |
| Browser test plays the entire episode through the real UI; state survives reload | `tests/e2e/episode.spec.ts`: opening to ending by UI only, then reload and verify solved state, designation and no replay | CI |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the local commands above.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source and content against the criteria and `docs/game-design.md`, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.

VERDICT: APPROVED

The proposed plan and test plan satisfy ISSUE-9's objective, constraints and six acceptance criteria. No blocking revisions are required. This is plan approval, not implementation or validation evidence.

| Contract area | Audit and evidence | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mystery facts and ending | Compared PLAN.md with docs/game-design.md: carrier parameters, 91-bit raster, Rev C 417 versus Rev A 714, 99306 receipt date, MOYE/MOYEN distinction, continuing power draw, January 2000 handshake and exact RELAY 07 block agree. | Covered |
| Content/engine boundary | Story, solutions, manuals, logs, transmissions and ending remain in content/. Generic tools dispatch by puzzle kind. src/content/schema.ts already supports the proposed raster, inquiry, archive search metadata and episode ending fields; src/content/browser.ts discovers content JSON recursively. | Covered |
| Distinct reasoning and dependencies | Carrier integration, raster/manual interpretation and archive investigation form a prerequisite chain. Tests cover refusal before prerequisites, grid-gated searches and matching carrier frequency/drift in the logbook fixture. | Covered |
| Pattern tool and revision trap | Width control and text raster are explicit. Tests derive both interpretations from actual manual bodies and verify correct acceptance and known-wrong feedback. src/puzzle/evaluate.ts already checks width and normalized reference. | Covered |
| Archive search and reconstruction | Pure search operates on game.archives(), which already filters requirements in src/puzzle/game.ts. Empty/unrelated queries exclude search-only records; 417 opens them after Pattern. Count-only inquiry feedback has both unit and UI verification. | Covered |
| Content breadth and ECHO | Multiple transmissions, several logs, stage reactions, escalating hints and contradictory memories are planned. Fixture assertions and independent content inspection cover these requirements. src/narrative/dialogue.ts supports conditions, priorities, failure thresholds and once-only lines. | Covered |
| Completion and persistence | Existing createGame records completed episodes and designation and calls persistence. New ending scene uses content lines; tests cover the revelation order, designation, completion, UI journey and reload without replay. src/progress/save.ts stores these fields. | Covered |
| Scope and protected paths | Touchpoints are content, engine/UI and tests; no dependencies or protected harness changes are proposed. Map and FORGE remain explicit follow-up work, outside this WorkUnit's listed acceptance criteria. | Covered |
| Validation ownership and feasibility | Focused Vitest, content validation and lint belong to developer; tester independently inspects and reuses applicable results; coordinator owns the full required policy. Browser execution stays in CI, consistent with sandbox limits. Existing tests/e2e/fixtures.ts serves production assets under /signal-lost/ without a listening server; .github/workflows/browser-tests.yml runs browser tests. | Covered |

## Evidence and handoff

Read SYSTEM_PROMPT.md and WORKUNIT.md first, then audited active PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md contains copies of the design and test-plan artifacts; it supplies no separate previous report or unmerged lesson requiring disposition. Verified the plan's source claims against game.ts, evaluate.ts, schema.ts, dialogue.ts, carrier.json, hub.ts and main.ts. There is no separate “What we know” section; the Sources and Edge cases claims inspected are supported by those modules.

Implementation boundaries are clear: content authors the evidence and progression requirements; pure archive search and existing puzzle evaluation enforce behavior; views and app wiring expose it through the real UI. Hub refresh must follow asynchronous puzzle completion so newly available tools appear immediately. Ending transition must follow newly recorded completion, while restored completion returns to the hub. These are implementation details within the approved plan.

Developer should produce the focused test results specified in TEST_PLAN.md. Tester should independently verify that the actual authored evidence supports each reconstruction answer and that the browser journey exercises the real tools. CI browser evidence may remain pending during sandbox roles but must pass before merge. Coordinator must run the complete trusted-base required policy on the final candidate. No implementation tests were run for this plan-only review.
